title: RAW one processed carrier keeps site-based names while conveyed likenesses and the using soul remain distinct
summary: RAW UNREVIEWED. Complete Steele id00090 follows natural/vital/animal spirit through purification, branched distribution, partial retention and brain passages; it explicitly carries likenesses to memory while remaining an instrument rather than the rational soul. A full account must separate carrier continuity, changed qualities/names, transported content and using agent, including the final impairment condition.

design.unit: Whole id00090, As wits and virtues are needed to the ruling of kind through others that oft lose use of reason. The entire historical physiology paragraph is mandatory within the owned chapter; not just the memory sentence.
design.mechanism: The source explicitly retains one spirit across further purification and site-dependent naming, distributes parts through a branched route, and distinguishes a travelling carrier from likenesses it bears and deposits. It then distinguishes that bodily carrier from the rational soul that uses it and makes bodily exercise depend on its service. These linked roles prevent a location/name change, content transfer or instrumental impairment from being silently equated with replacement of the soul or with identity of carrier and representation.
design.positive_consequence: A source-content account that makes natural/vital/animal three unrelated agents loses the explicit same-spirit statement; one that treats the memory likenesses as the spirit itself loses the bear-and-deposit relation; one that treats memory as the final sink of every portion contradicts the retention/distribution and spinal continuation. Identifying this bodily spirit with the rational soul contradicts the closing qualification. Each mistake can retain the same organ and faculty names while changing a written consequence.
design.meaning_anchor_needed: A later candidate must write a coherent antecedent chain for the carrier and distinguish it from the likenesses carried/deposited and the soul whose acts depend on its service. Site, branch, process and content roles must be bound in a complete prospective passage; a sequence of organ names, generic path marker or imagined three-level diagram does not supply that anchor. This RAW selects no target phrase or word value.
whole_source_duties: Opening: bodily faculties require spirits for their operation; spirit is described as subtle/airy bodily substance generated through heat, not automatically the rational soul.

Physicians-attributed liver account: heat works on blood, boiling generates smoke, veins purify it into natural spirit; that spirit then makes blood subtle and moves/sends it to limbs. Preserve the mediator acting on its earlier source medium; no measured feedback law is supplied.

The same spirit travels toward the heart, is further purified through the described movement/smiting, and is called vital. Its spread to limbs and the works it governs remain distinct from a mere change of label.

Left-heart artery divides into downward and upward branches; downward supply serves lower limbs, upward divides into right arm, left arm and brain/higher parts. Retain all named branches and their recipients without assuming any corresponding manuscript picture/count.

The same spirit enters brain cavities, is further refined and changed into animal spirit, generated in the foremost cavity. Some spreads to sensation limbs; some remains for common sense/common wit/imagination. No assertion that all incoming spirit is consumed or that one indivisible parcel occupies every branch.

The account proceeds to the Logistic middle cavity for intellect/understanding; after informing intellect, it passes to memory bearing prints of likeness made in the other cavities and deposits them there. The carrier, carried representations, their provenance and storage destination are different roles.

From hindmost brain parts it passes through spinal marrow to moving sinews, for voluntary movement in lower parts. Keep this continuation as well as the memory sequence; memory deposition is not declared the terminal destination of all spirit.

Closing explicitly calls it one and the same spirit named natural/vital/animal by liver/heart/head working. This is asserted continuity across processing/naming descriptions, not unchanged chemical composition or identity of every distributed portion.

The Augustine-attributed qualification denies that this spirit is the rational soul and calls it its car/instrument. Through it the soul is joined to the body; without its service no soul act is perfectly exercised in the body. Impairment/hindrance is then linked to disrupted accord and inhibited works, with historical mental-disorder examples. Preserve attribution and perfectly; no modern diagnosis or universal medical fact is established.
rivals: Site changes rename three independent substances with no continuity; the source explicitly states one and the same spirit.
One unchanged indivisible parcel travels every branch and remains at all earlier sites; the source has partial distribution/retention and further purification.
Likenesses, their carrier and rational soul are identical objects; the source distinguishes bear/deposit and instrument/user roles.
Because the soul depends on the spirit, the spirit is sufficient for perfect cognition or causes the soul to exist; neither follows from the stated instrumental requirement.
The memory route is a modern neural transmission theory or the historical impairment examples validate modern diagnoses.

related_predecessors.difference: One digestive stage across multiple sites separates stage kind/episode/site. Here the whole source explicitly changes processing/names of one carrier and introduces carried likenesses plus the instrument/soul distinction; site continuity itself is not new.
Instrument configuration supports different operations in overlapping organs; it does not by itself give this carrier-versus-payload or instrument-versus-soul argument.

Conduit delivery, local uptake and changing nutritive intermediates are already retained. The proposed distinct content is representation-bearing/deposition and explicit agent/instrument separation, not a new organ name.

known_countercases: Further purification/animal change coexists with same-spirit naming; do not equate continuity with unchanged qualities.
Some spirit remains while some is distributed, and there is further travel after the memory passage; no universal consume-all or single terminal-sink model.
The explicit non-soul clause prevents promoting the instrument to the using agent; perfectly qualifies the immediate no-act statement.
costs_and_gaps: Long complete paragraph with a substantial branched-anatomy and cognition duty load; no deletion of hard branches or final historical examples.
Same spirit is a generic/collective historical account; exact numerical parcel identity and distribution amounts are not supplied.
The source does not specify an exact physical inscription medium for prints of likeness or assign every print to one uniquely named originating cavity.
The spirit/soul vocabulary is archaic and attributed; no critical terminology collation, independent tradition or clinical truth is established.
Particular content is distinct in declared source duties, but exact scientific novelty, target capacity and semantic binding remain unreviewed.
